requirements.text: Parallel CodeWiki write roles default to isolated Git worktrees/branches per task and role, with an explicit solo-mode override only when safe.
A worktree factory/orchestrator prepares, records, heartbeats, verifies, and cleans builder, validator, and publisher worktrees with branch/path/base/head/tree/clean/digest metadata.

Task-close and publication use a publisher/merge queue: builders produce branch or patch refs, validators verify immutable refs from fresh worktrees, and publishers serialize final merge/commit/generated-state updates with clean proof.
Artifact wait/wake records name exact branch, patch, claim, and next safe action so sessions do not block solely on unrelated shared worktree dirtiness.

Once the isolated worktree/publisher path lands, /wiki-session-handoff compatibility cleanup should remove or extract the shim in a dedicated worktree unless an explicit migration task requires preservation.

diff_table.current_state: Parallel agents write in the repository root/shared worktree, so one session's dirty files block unrelated or follow-up cleanup sessions even when artifact status is released.
diff_table.desired_state: CodeWiki write roles default to isolated Git worktrees/branches per task and role; root worktree becomes coordination/publisher surface unless an explicit solo-mode override is selected.
diff_table.rationale: Filesystem isolation removes cross-session dirty-state blocking while preserving artifact-status coordination for semantic/path conflicts.
diff_table.risk: Medium: changes workflow orchestration and requires careful cleanup of temporary worktrees.

diff_table.current_state: Artifact status can record worktree metadata but does not create, assign, verify, or clean role worktrees.
diff_table.desired_state: Add a CodeWiki worktree factory/orchestrator that prepares, records, heartbeats, verifies, and cleans builder/validator/publisher worktrees, including base/head/tree SHA, branch, clean state, and working-tree digest when needed.
diff_table.rationale: Metadata without enforcement still leaves agents guessing and causes manual coordination stalls.
diff_table.risk: Medium: introduces Git-operation surface that must be safe and deterministic.

diff_table.current_state: Task-close/publication is blocked until dirty shared worktree is manually committed or cleared; validation reports and generated CodeWiki state add more dirty files during review.
diff_table.desired_state: Introduce a publisher/merge queue: builders produce patch or branch refs from isolated worktrees, validators verify immutable refs from fresh worktrees, and a publisher serializes merge/commit/CodeWiki generated-state updates with final clean proof.
diff_table.rationale: Separating build, validate, and publish roles keeps validation independent and makes close proof a controlled final step instead of a shared-working-tree scramble.
diff_table.risk: High: changes close/publication mechanics; must not weaken validation proof.

diff_table.current_state: Waiting sessions report vague blockers like 'dirty from other session' and resume only after manual user interpretation.
diff_table.desired_state: Wait/wake records should name exact branch/patch/claim blockers and next safe action, e.g. 'consume TASK-006 validated branch X' or 'wait for publisher commit Y'; agents should not block solely on unrelated shared dirtiness.
diff_table.rationale: Actionable wait state prevents deadlocks and keeps cleanup tasks moving when their real dependency lands.
diff_table.risk: Low-medium: mostly state/queue semantics and messaging, but needs tests.

diff_table.current_state: Compatibility shims such as /wiki-session-handoff can linger because cleanup/removal work shares dirty files with stabilization work.
diff_table.desired_state: After the isolated worktree/publisher path lands, schedule hard removal/extraction cleanup as a dedicated task/worktree; compatibility preservation is allowed only when a migration task explicitly requires it.
diff_table.rationale: This aligns with the other agent's recommendation: cleanup should remove/extract the shim instead of preserving accidental compatibility, but only after the workflow can do that safely.
diff_table.risk: Medium: removal can break users if not gated by migration/compatibility tests.

accepted_decisions.summary: Default CodeWiki write roles should use isolated Git worktrees/branches rather than the shared repository root.
CodeWiki should provide a worktree factory/orchestrator that prepares, records, verifies, and cleans role worktrees.
Task-close/publication should use a publisher/merge queue with immutable validated refs and final clean proof.
Wait/wake records should name exact branch/patch/claim blockers and next safe actions instead of vague shared-dirty blockers.
After isolated worktree/publisher flow lands, /wiki-session-handoff cleanup should be hard removal/extraction unless an explicit migration task preserves compatibility.

assumptions: Existing role/worktree metadata can be extended rather than replaced.
Git worktree operations can be offered behind explicit CodeWiki tooling and safety checks.
Publisher queue should serialize canonical root commits and CodeWiki generated-state changes.
open_questions: Should worktree roots live under a default repo-local ignored directory, an external temp directory, or a configurable path?
Should branch naming use cw/<task>/<role>/<session> or another convention?
Should publisher queue be a CodeWiki tool, Pi command, or internal agency role first?
non_goals: Do not weaken fresh validation, task-close, or publication proof requirements.
Do not remove /wiki-session-handoff until isolated worktree/publisher flow is implemented and validated.
Do not make artifact status records the filesystem source of truth.
